name: Hiram
bio: Hiram was the king of Tyre who sent messengers to David along with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons, who built David a palace after he was established in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:11) — a gesture of friendship and recognition of David's growing kingdom. Hiram's alliance with the house of David continued into the next generation, when he supplied the cedar and craftsmen for Solomon's building of the temple (1 Kings 5).
